data.credibility: Management demonstrates mixed reliability. They successfully deliver core revenue and capex guidance, such as achieving 16.3% revenue growth and Rs. 1,000 crores capex in FY26. However, they frequently drop or stop mentioning specific portfolio and expansion targets.

lines.line: Promised 30-plus new hotels in FY26; status left as slipping due to lack of mention.
Management fees expected to grow with strong EBITDA flow-through; kept on track.
Promised new business growth of 30% in H2; missed with actual FY26 growth at 16.3%.
Taj Ganges 100-key expansion expected Q3/Q4 FY26; delivered successfully.
Taj Lucknow 95-key expansion by 2027; dropped without further updates.
Double-digit revenue growth guidance for FY26; kept, delivering 16.3% actual growth.
Capex of Rs. 1,000 to 1,200 crores in FY26; kept, delivering Rs. 1,000 crores.
Scale Tree of Life portfolio to 100 hotels; dropped from later communications.
Expected 60 plus openings in FY27; dropped in subsequent quarters.
Ginger and new business 25% plus revenue growth; kept as 25.0% was delivered.
Atmantan projected revenue of INR 100 crores in FY27; dropped.
Brij acquisition contribution of INR 100 crores in FY27; dropped.
Recent acquisitions to contribute INR 250-300 crores in FY27; dropped.
Double-digit revenue growth in FY27; on track with 18.2% achieved so far.
Annual capex of INR 1,000 to 1,200 crores in FY27; dropped from tracking.
Ginger brand to reach 250 hotels by end of FY27; on track.
Portfolio approaching 650 hotels to cross in current month; slipping.
Ginger brand on track to reach 150 operational hotels by March 2027; pending.
Hotel segment revenue to grow 17% to 19% in FY27; on track at 18.2%.

bull: Revenue compounded at a strong 43.8% annually over five years, reaching a TTM revenue of ₹10,431 cr.
EBITDA margin has widened significantly from -23.0% in FY21 to 33.0% in FY26.
Balance sheet is lightly geared with borrowings at ₹3,471 cr against net worth of ₹13,640 cr (debt/equity 0.25).
bear: Growth is slowing down noticeably, dropping to 18.6% annually over three years compared to 43.8% over five years.
Valuation appears demanding with a P/E ratio of 63.0 against an ROE of 15.4% and ROCE of 17.1%.
Working-capital days have stretched considerably from -555 days to -37 days over the five-year period.
